description: Source-reviewed command and flow mutation candidates. Native outcomes are recorded separately.

mutants.old: role == ExtrusionRole::erSolidInfill || role == ExtrusionRole::erTopSolidInfill || role == ExtrusionRole::erBottomSurface
mutants.new: role != ExtrusionRole::erSolidInfill && role != ExtrusionRole::erTopSolidInfill && role != ExtrusionRole::erBottomSurface
mutants.description: Apply the compensation to ordinary perimeter roles instead of solid-infill roles.
Interpolate a zero-length line instead of returning identity flow.
Allow duplicate model lengths that the parser contract rejects.
Route M6211 timing to non-Elegoo printers and skip it for Elegoo models.

Allow an out-of-range filament index to enter process_filament_change.
